scope: expansion-0151 through expansion-0155, 80 page illustrations plus 5 covers

visualReview.coverage: Read all five final text-ready manuscripts, all page scene notes, characters and editorial-004-older.md before drawing. Viewed all 85 first-draft images in five contact sheets, then all five revised contact sheets. Enlarged 0151 p05/p12/p13, 0152 p03/p15, 0153 p08/p11/p14, 0154 p04/p08/p12/p13, 0155 p04/p15. After final corrections, re-viewed all five final sheets and enlarged the affected hand/leaf/count/drawer details.
corrections: 0151: five facial pebbles only, continuously rearranged rather than conventional eyes/mouth; raised speaking basket and lowered finished basket kept distinct. Removed duplicate basket, attached writing arm to shoulder, supported the sister stone in both children/guest holding scenes, strengthened sister outline; underside stripe shown during recovery, five pebbles appear on sister only in final narrative page. Recording papers sit on the table, shallow resting bed remains unburied.

0152: every real body, expression and held object is reused under one exact vertical reflection transform; imagined objects live inside dotted thought frames. Raised leaf to hide one side of the face and match the hand; map covers both actual/reflected faces. Snail-shell bakery, notched cookie, faint temporary window and exit remain consistent. Cloud fits inside the hollow question-mark circle without hiding the rim.

0153: six recording stones conserved: two saved snores plus four later observations, with mixed box/hand/body placements; forehead, chest, palm and heel placements retained. White cloth save state and wash-before-reuse stage retained. Changed background stones away from recording-stone purple. Mole leans with ear against the giant hand, rubbing hand reaches its stone, giant tries a visibly closed fist. No literal carpenter is drawn; final sound remains unexplained.

0154: magic cloth connects opposite gripping hands only while held jointly. One soup bowl and one empty tear-catching bowl, supporting stools and empty friend chair retained. Sad girl expressions replace unintended smiles during avoidance; removed stray face line. Shoelace hands reach the shoe after release, otter laughs with the whole cloth; later girl tears mark her own dark sleeve. Four remaining white shells and two pear halves shown; both hands reach the drawing sheet; brown curly-haired departing friend has orange bag.

0155: sailor remains clipped within the light-blue red-sail stamp, with held white hat in final frozen pose. Glass-box waves lie on the box bottom; true sea is gray-green with pale wave line. Three letter sheets preserved. Open drawers attach to cabinet and final empty drawer sits behind the child, clear of face; cup rests on sill, stamp support and envelope holding improved. Signature stroke appears on receipt while final stamp stays still; no sailor returns to the empty drawer.
visualReview.limits: Simplified original vector picture-book illustrations. Review covers scene continuity, visible anatomy, relevant props, supported placement and overlaps. It does not certify hand-painted bitmap artwork, audio quality, browser layout, deployment or child-user testing.
